purpose: Trace every model-certificate transaction attempt inside the exact failing 1e-5 cm/day service window at the unchanged t=0.004-day origin, separating solver, mass and temporal rejection paths and recording how attempt duration changes.

fixed_conditions.history: Published C2a zero window, then published native service windows at 1e-8, 1e-7 and 1e-6 cm/day.
fixed_conditions.target_window: Uniform infiltration 1e-5 cm/day, t0=0.004 day, duration=0.001 day.
fixed_conditions.instrumentation: A source override of src/transaction/mod_transaction_reference.f90 compiled only into the local research library via the existing builder --source-override option. No tracked production source or production binary is changed. Trace only the target interval and skip the later isolated probes so records describe service transaction calls.

gates.two_fresh_processes: Each process must produce byte-identical canonical JSON and byte-identical ordered trace records.
gates.state_rollback: Full service rejection must preserve profile hash, storage, all participant revisions and ledgers.
gates.production_delta: None. Instrumentation exists only as a generated source override and is excluded from src/ and production build inputs.

interpretation: Classify each attempted interval by the actual transaction gate that rejected it. Do not infer that a relaxed budget is physically acceptable from trace behavior.
